Lists

Unordered lists use the * marker:

  • a first item
  • a second item with code and bold
  • a third item continues on the next line because prose can wrap

Ordered lists use the . marker:

  1. step one
  2. step two

Blank lines can separate items in one list:

  • separated
  • but still in one list

Checklists mark individual items:

  • finished
  • not finished
  • an ordinary item in the same list

A backslash keeps [ literal where checklist syntax is read:

  • [ ] not a checkbox
